tags.label: Greeting
tags.definition: The message opens with a greeting or sign-off phrase ('Guten Morgen', 'gm', 'hallo zusammen', '73', 'cześć'), whatever else it says.

tags.label: Weather
tags.definition: Contains a weather or environment report: temperature, humidity, pressure, wind, rain, pollen, water level, nowcast or telemetry values.

tags.label: QSL
tags.definition: Mentions a QSL card or contact confirmation: a request for a QSL, sending or confirming one, QSL bot/event-station exchanges ('pse QSL', 'QSL via bureau', 'QSL received, tnx').

tags.label: Test
tags.definition: A short message that tests reach or equipment: 'test', 'Test 1 2 3', 'Testnachricht', 'reichweitentest', radio check.

tags.label: Question
tags.definition: Any interrogative message: a question to the network, including setup and help questions, requests for a contact or frequency, radio checks and small talk ('hat jemand ...?', 'hoert mich jemand?', 'wie geht's?').

tags.label: QSO
tags.definition: Human conversation: replies, statements, reports, chit-chat, thanks. Derived, not matched: a message with none of the automated tags (bot, weather, node, software, bulletin, pota-sota, alert, time) is qso, alongside any greeting, question, test or qsl. Weather blocks qso unless there is conversation evidence (leading @CALL addressee, 1:1 DM, or a question); a weather report with only a greeting is not qso.

tags.label: Bulletin
tags.definition: News or bulletin for many readers: contest calendars, club-evening and net reminders, event announcements, newsletters -- informational rather than urgent.

tags.label: POTA/SOTA
tags.definition: Automated activator/award spot feed: '[POTA] SP9NLI @ Park | 18.089 MHz CW', '[SOTA] SP0KE @ Summit | 14.330 MHz SSB', '[DYPLOM] ... | 7.074 MHz FT8'. A human sentence that merely mentions POTA, SOTA or an award is not a spot.

tags.label: Alert
tags.definition: Emergency, warning or urgent safety-relevant information: Notfall, SOS, earthquake, storm/flood warning, outage alert. A routine reminder with a warning emoji is a bulletin, not an alert.

tags.label: Bot
tags.definition: Command to a node or bot, a bot's reply, or a machine protocol frame: '--setowngw ...', '>ping', 'pong', 'MH(3): ...', 'Route: ...', 'unbekannter Befehl:', command help output, file-transfer/MCF payloads ('MCF1|...', 'FTS|...').

tags.label: Software
tags.definition: Announces a program, firmware version, web tool or software URL: 'MeshcomWebDesk V1.12.2 - https://...', version banners, firmware download links.

tags.label: Node
tags.definition: Automated station or node presence or status announcement: 'X is online', location/locator/QTH banner, BBS/gateway/digipeater availability, battery/supply notice, telemetry counter line, HTML or emoji URL advert. NOT a human message that merely mentions a callsign or locator.
